summary: Iteration 50 – frontend-only verification of the new Fairy Gully theme and related welcome-dialog / regression changes. All primary acceptance criteria pass: welcome dialog shows 11 theme tiles + 1 'Let Fate Decide' tile (12 total) with Fairy Gully (mushroom) and Cyberscape (renamed) present; subtitle contains 'Choose yours.'; no peek/fade happens when picking a tile (dialog stays visible until ENTER FORK·FATE is clicked). No seasonal auto-default regression – html[data-ff-theme] is 'dark' with no ff_theme in localStorage before selection. Fairy scene renders fairy-gully-bg + exactly 6 fluttering butterflies, 8 wisps, 4 pond ripples, ambiance-scene-fairy container present. Deal button computed backgroundColor is rgb(30,122,74) (green) in fairy theme, and reverts to red rgb(224,30,38) in Reaper theme confirming green overrides are correctly scoped. Guided ritual in fairy theme renders on medium-green surface with light-beige tiles and green icons/accents (step 3 verified visually). SEAL_ICONS.fairy = MushroomIcon confirmed in source. Fairy deal flow: card-back parent border rgb(230,178,58) (gold) with mushroom emblem img (/fairy-mushroom.png) and gold gradient shadow; reveal quote uses reaper-line testid but text is a MAGICAL line ('The fae have spoken.' / 'Woodland magic marks this place.' both observed) — not the reaper line — and theme-flourish mounts with data-flourish=fairy. Audio assets /shuffle-fairy.wav, /reveal-fairy.wav, and image /fairy-mushroom.png all return HTTP 200. Header Theme dropdown lists Fairy Gully with mushroom SVG and an active check mark; Cyberpunk correctly renamed to 'Cyberscape'. Cyberscape theme applies (data-ff-theme=cyber) with matrix background active on load. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is 1575 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting further (already partially decomposed via hooks in prior iterations).
reveal-line testid is reused across themes (still named 'reaper-line'). Not a bug but a semantic mismatch; a future refactor could rename to 'reveal-line' for clarity, keeping alias for tests.
test_credentials: None required (Google Places key already configured; ZIP 10001 returns real results).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fairy theme fully verified in iteration 50. Welcome dialog persistence key is 'ff_theme_chosen' (set to '1' to skip); active theme key is 'ff_theme'. Guided intro opens on every page load — use `document.querySelector('button:has-text("Skip intro")')` or the Skip intro button (button:has-text('Skip intro')) to dismiss. To directly deal without header collision, dispatch click via `document.querySelector('[data-testid="spin-roulette-button"]').click()`. Shuffle takes ~7–9s. Card back's gold outer border comes from the parent element (rgb(230,178,58)), not the [data-testid=card-back] element itself — inspect parentElement border for the gilded frame. The reveal-quote element retains data-testid='reaper-line' across all themes despite showing theme-specific text.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Fairy theme, welcome dialog changes, seasonal-default removal, cyber rename, green scoping, and audio/image assets all behave per spec.
